title: Login Security
description: Manage failed login lockout and reset window settings

lockoutEnabled.label: Enable Login Failure Lockout
lockoutEnabled.desc: When enabled, accounts will be locked after consecutive failures reach the threshold.

maxFailedAttempts.label: Max Failed Attempts
maxFailedAttempts.desc: Account will be locked after exceeding this count.

failureResetMinutes.label: Failure Reset Window
failureResetMinutes.desc: Failure count will be reset if no further failures occur within this time.

captchaEnabled.label: Enable Captcha Trigger
captchaEnabled.desc: When enabled, captcha will be required after consecutive failures reach the threshold.

captchaTriggerAttempts.label: Captcha Trigger Attempts
captchaTriggerAttempts.desc: Captcha will be required when failure count reaches this value.

validation.captchaTriggerRange: Captcha trigger attempts cannot be greater than max failed attempts
